title: Assurance knowledge candidate revocation record v1
$comment: The receipt `knowledge_feedback.revoke` returns and `apply_revocation` applies. It is a separate top-level document rather than a $defs entry of the candidate v2 schema because it is persisted on its own (knowledge_revocation) and served on its own (revocation_receipts); a reader must be able to validate one receipt without holding the candidate it belongs to. `export_blocked` is const true: a revocation that did not block export would be a note, not a revocation.
